name: oxylabs-web-api
description: Live web search, page reading and company lookup through the Oxylabs Web API: real SERP results, country-accurate, pages that a plain fetch cannot retrieve, and company profiles. Runs on the Oxylabs-hosted MCP server with your Web API key.

OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY.title: Oxylabs Web API key
OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY.description: From a Web API instance in the Oxylabs dashboard (dashboard.oxylabs.io). Keys from other Oxylabs products don't work.
